# Copilot Instructions for Nuxt Portfolio CMS

## Big picture
- Nuxt 4 + Vue 3 (`<script setup>`) app with file-based CMS via `@nuxt/content`.
- All content is YAML/Markdown in `content/` and validated by Zod schemas in `content.config.ts`.
- UI is Nuxt UI (Tailwind-based); motion animations use `motion-v` and appear in landing sections.
- OG images are generated via `nuxt-og-image` and URLs depend on `NUXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL`.
- Primary hosting is Cloudflare Pages (Nitro preset configured in `nuxt.config.ts`).

## Where things live
- Content schemas: `content.config.ts` (authoritative required fields/types).
- Homepage sections: `app/components/landing/` (Hero, About, Blog, FAQ, Testimonials).
- Routes: `app/pages/` (index/about/projects/blog); blog detail uses `app/pages/blog/[...slug].vue`.
- Global config: `app/app.config.ts` (colors, profile, UI settings).

## Content workflow (important)
- Add/edit homepage and page content in `content/index.yml` and `content/{about,projects,blog}.yml`.
- Add projects in `content/projects/*.yml` and blog posts in `content/blog/*.md`.
- Blog front matter is normalized by `scripts/update-blog-frontmatter.mjs`.
  - Commands: `pnpm blog:update`, `pnpm blog:update-file <path>`, `pnpm blog:refresh-images`.
  - Pexels images require `NUXT_PEXELS_API_KEY` (or `PEXELS_API_KEY`) in `.env`.

## Conventions and patterns
- Prefer Nuxt UI components and Tailwind utilities; avoid custom CSS unless necessary.
- Use content types generated by `@nuxt/content` when typing props (e.g., `IndexCollectionItem`).
- Motion pattern: `<Motion :initial="{ opacity: 0, scale: 1.1, filter: 'blur(20px)' }" ...>`

## Dev/CI commands (pnpm only)
- `pnpm dev`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm preview`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm lint:fix`, `pnpm typecheck`.
- Build uses increased Node memory (`NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096`) in scripts/CI.

## Integration points
- Cloudflare Pages deployment expects `dist` output; Nitro preset is `cloudflare-pages`.
- Optional NuxtHub deploy workflow exists under `.github/workflows/`.
